channel.title: Japan Small-Cap Filings in English
channel.description: English fact summaries of Japanese corporate filings from EDINET.

item.title: Morigumi Co., Ltd.: Asahi Kasei Homes launches tender offer for Morigumi at 564 yen per share
item.description: Tender offer price is 564 yen per common share. | Tender period runs from 2026-11-13 to 2027-01-07 (35 business days). | Minimum purchase is 11,922,100 shares; no maximum is set. | Filer held 9,911,000 shares (30.26%) before the offer; ownership after the offer at minimum is 66.69%. | Target's board approved on 2026-11-12 to support the offer and recommend tendering. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: NEC Corporation: NEC launches tender offer for up to 32,559,000 own shares at ¥3,462 per share.
item.description: Tender offer start date: 2026-11-13 | Offer price ¥3,462, a 22.7% discount to the 2026-11-09 Prime Market close of ¥4,479 | Planned purchase: 32,559,000 shares (2.45%), the portion NTT will tender | NTT holds 65,118,000 shares (4.90%) and will sell the other 32,559,000 shares through a block sale to institutional investors | Funding: entirely from own funds, about ¥112,741 million (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Mori-Gumi Co., Ltd.: Mori-Gumi board supports Asahikasei Homuzu's tender offer at 564 yen per share and recommends tendering.
item.description: Tender offer period: 2026-11-13 to 2027-01-07 (35 business days) | Offer price: 564 yen per share of common stock | Minimum number of shares to be purchased: 11,922,100 shares; no maximum | Offeror holds 9,911,000 shares (30.26%) of Mori-Gumi before the offer | Board resolution to support the offer adopted on 2026-11-12; Haseko Corporation (second-largest shareholder, 2,624,000 shares, 8.01%) agreed to tender its shares (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: TSUGAMI CORPORATION: TSUGAMI expects to receive a 222,777 thousand HKD dividend from a consolidated subsidiary.

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: KURABO INDUSTRIES LTD.: Kurabo plans to sell 12 investment securities holdings, expecting a 150億円 (15 billion yen) gain.
item.description: Event date: 2026-11-12, the board of directors resolution date | Part of the Accelerate'27 medium-term plan to reduce policy shareholdings | Sale of 12 issues of investment securities planned for 2026-11 to 2026-12 | Gain on sale of investment securities expected to be 150億円 (15 billion yen) in extraordinary income | Gain to be recorded in the individual and consolidated results for the third quarter of FY ending March 2027 (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: CENTRAL AUTOMOTIVE PRODUCTS LTD.: Central Automotive Products approves employee stock ownership trust plan with 135,100-share disposal.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-13 to introduce a stock-grant ESOP trust plan covering three fiscal years, ending 2027-03-31 to 2029-03-31. | Treasury stock disposal of 135,100 common shares to the ESOP trust account at Nihon Master Trust Bank, Ltd. | Issue price 1,982 yen per share; total issue amount 267,768,200 yen; payment date 2026-12-03. | Eligible employees number 295 as of the board meeting date, excluding non-resident employees. | Shares delivered from the trust carry no transfer restrictions; no capital increase is involved. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Japan Display Inc.: Japan Display reports gains and losses from asset sales, impairments and litigation provision in Q2.

Not investment advice.)

item.title: FUMAKILLA LIMITED: FUMAKILLA reports sale of one investment securities holding, recording 1,585 million yen gain.

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: Remixpoint,inc.: Remixpoint reports 3,695 million yen sales increase from revaluing crypto-assets at interim period-end.

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: UMC Electronics Co., Ltd.: UMC Electronics reports 562 million yen special retirement payments at China subsidiary.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12. | For the six months from 2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30, 562 million yen in special retirement payments was recorded as an extraordinary loss. | The payments were recorded as restructuring costs to optimize the production and management structure of the China subsidiary. | The extraordinary loss is reflected in the Q2 (interim) consolidated earnings report for the fiscal year ending March 2027, published 2026-11-12. | The filing states it was submitted late because it was not filed when originally due. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: KONAKA CO.,LTD.: Konaka to record impairment loss and deferred tax asset write-down for fiscal year ending September 2026.

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: KATO WORKS CO.,LTD.: KATO WORKS reports ACE KATO PRIVATE LIMITED became a specified subsidiary on 2026-08-25.

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: FUJIMAK CORPORATION: FUJIMAK reports gain of 874 million yen from sale of investment securities.
item.description: Event occurred from 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-30. | The company sold part of its investment securities holdings. | An investment securities sale gain of 874 million yen will be recorded as extraordinary income in the fiscal year ending December 2026. | The report was filed under Article 19(2)(12) and Article 19 of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Information. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Kojima Co.,Ltd.: Kojima to dispose of 76,300 treasury shares under restricted stock compensation plan
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-13 to dispose of 76,300 treasury shares to executive officers and employees (section manager level and above) | Disposal price is JPY 1,448 per share, with a total disposal amount of JPY 110,482,400 | Allottees number 116 persons, receiving 76,300 shares in total | Payment date is 2026-11-30, and the disposal is made as an in-kind contribution of monetary claims | Transfer restriction period runs from the payment date until retirement, and release conditions apply over up to five years (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Kyowa Electronic Instruments Co., Ltd.: Kyowa Electronic Instruments to absorb three wholly owned subsidiaries effective 2027-01-01.
item.description: Board resolved and merger agreement signed on 2026-10-26; the filer is the surviving company. | Absorbed companies are Kabushiki Kaisha Yamagata Kyowa Denki, Kabushiki Kaisha Kofu Kyowa Denki and Kabushiki Kaisha Kyowa Service Center, each 100% owned by the filer. | Planned merger effective date is 2027-01-01; no shares or other consideration will be allotted. | The merger is a simplified merger for the filer and a short-form merger for the absorbed companies, so no shareholder meeting approval is planned. | Yamagata Kyowa Denki and Kofu Kyowa Denki are specified subsidiaries; the filing states they will be dissolved by the merger. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Daishi Hokuetsu Financial Group, Inc.: Daishi Hokuetsu Financial Group reports planned representative director changes effective 2027-04-01.
item.description: Board resolved the representative director changes at its meeting on 2026-11-13. | Fukai Akihiko (born 1960-11-03), currently representative director and president of Kabushiki Kaisha Gunma Ginko, is to become representative director and group CEO on 2027-04-01 (planned); holds 0 shares of the filer and 321,213 shares of Gunma Ginko as of the filing date. | Shokuguri Michiro, currently representative director and president, is to become representative director and chairman on 2027-04-01 (planned). | Takahashi Shin (born 1962-02-23, representative director and senior managing director) and Shibata Ken (born 1967-01-19, representative managing director) cease to be representative directors on 2027-04-01 (planned); they hold 174,326 and 190,716 shares respectively. | The changes accompany a share exchange with Gunma Ginko as the wholly owned subsidiary, subject to an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 2026-12-23 and the share exchange effective date of 2027-04-01 (planned). (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: ASTERIA Corporation: ASTERIA reports investment valuation loss of about 284 million yen on SpaceX investment for Q2
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-13, disclosed under Article 19(2)(19) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Information. | The SpaceX investment is held through Asteria AI & Robotics Inc., a 100% investment subsidiary. | Investment valuation loss of about 284 million yen recognized for the period 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30. | Cumulative valuation gain of about 1,766 million yen on the securities for 2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30. | The securities are owned by an overseas subsidiary, so there is no impact on standalone results. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: TAIHEI DENGYO KAISHA,LTD.: Taihei Dengyo resolves to continue director stock compensation trust and treasury share disposal

Not investment advice.)

item.title: JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd.: JAPAN POST BANK to dispose 2,895,200 treasury shares for employee share trust plan.

Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)
